purpose: Teach: カジュアル/リベラル/オールド/エコノミー/ノーマン/ヘルパー/カセット/イレブン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカジュアルなお出かけを楽しまれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really enjoys a casual day out.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft opening. Gentle pace that creates space for the memory. Slight smile in the voice — fond of his father, not her own words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとリベラルな新聞のニュース観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched the news together — something about current events.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick opening burst of enthusiasm. Light in the voice — proud to be sharing. Small pause before the second clause, checking if she's interested.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオールドカーの博物館に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad took me to this old car museum. It was wonderful.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Measured pace. Eyes clearly on that afternoon. The word 'wonderful' lands gently — not overstated, just honest appreciation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと海外旅行のエコノミークラスのお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about his trip abroad once — he flew economy class.
lines.style: Animated, boyishly pleased. Fast clip on the opening. 'Economy class' gets a tiny note of wonder in it — the detail he thought was worth keeping.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ノーマン・ベイツの映画は怖い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Norman Bates film — the one in that old movie — really scared him.
lines.style: Warm amusement underneath. Conversational, almost conspiratorial. Soft on 'scared him' — endeared by his confession, not mocking it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのヘルパーさんと挨拶したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I said hello to Grandpa's helper the other day.
lines.style: Simple, matter-of-fact. No flourish. Small pride in the politeness of it. The quietness of someone who notices when to be considerate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカセットテープの聴き方を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me how to listen to cassette tapes. Taught me the old way.
lines.style: Tender, unhurried. Lingering on the verb 'showed' — the gift was in the teaching, not the object. Slight warmth at the corner of the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとサッカー日本代表イレブンの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched the Japan national soccer team play. It was amazing.
lines.style: Bright, breathless finish. Quick energy on the opening. 'Amazing' lands with genuine excitement — not performed, just the real feeling of a child who got to share something with his father.
